Stack Overflow analysis compares developer survey data across recent years, highlighting rapid AI tool adoption alongside a growth in user skepticism.

Key points:
• AI tool adoption among developers reached 79% in 2025.
• Skepticism among learners rose from 6.4% in 2024 to 26.3% in 2025; this is a learners-only finding.
• ChatGPT and GitHub Copilot remain the primary gateways for out-of-the-box assistants.

Why it matters: Understanding shifts in developer sentiment and trust helps professionals calibrate how much to rely on automated tooling versus human judgment.

Try this: Choose one small AI-assisted coding task, run your own test cases, and record one error you caught and how you corrected it.

Source: Stack Overflow Blog

OpenAI News announced the launch of GPT-6.1 Sol, targeting coding and computer use at a fraction of standard token prices.

Key points:
• GPT-6.1 Sol provides near-Astra intelligence for coding and professional work.
• API input and output token prices are set at one-fifth of standard Astra rates.

Why it matters: Lower-cost access to advanced coding models allows developers to experiment more freely with automated workflows and agent-based applications.

Try this: Experiment with the new model endpoint on a small personal script to test its performance on routine coding tasks.

Source: OpenAI News
